title: GIF frame strip: duplicate a frame from the right-click menu
description: Fabio, 2026-09-20: nothing in the GIF workspace repeats a frame. The frames store is content-addressed, so a duplicate is a second entry in the frames list and zero extra bytes on disk. Duplicate frame joins the strip's right-click menu beside Delete, stages like every other strip edit (the pill's Update/Apply saves it), and carries the frame's cut-out mask onto the copy.
